title: activity icon in activity pager instead of application icons, mixed pager
line: The Activity Pager can now show each activity's icon instead of its name or number.
explanation: Activities have a name and an icon, but the Activity Pager's display options only offered no text, the activity number or the activity name, so the icon was never shown; with window icons on, each rectangle only showed the icons of the apps inside it. The pager model now exposes the activity icon as its decoration, and the activity pager gets a new "Activity icon" choice in its display options (the group is labelled "Display:" there) that draws the icon in each activity rectangle, above the window outlines.

commits.message:
applets/pager: allow showing activity icons in the activity pager

Activities have an icon, but the activity pager could only label them
with a number or a name. Add an "Activity icon" display option to the
activity pager, which draws each activity's icon in its rectangle.

BUG: 364535

media.caption: Activity Pager on master: only the activity name (or number) can be shown; window icons are the only icons.
With "Activity icon" selected, each activity shows its own icon (Default, Graphics, Work).
Activity Pager settings: new "Activity icon" option under Display.
